## Mechanism

## OP-20 Disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** BS-synthetic pricing; qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper realizes ~14% of headline. Not real-fills validated.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 run appears to cover 2025-Q1 through 2026-Q2 (6 quarters), NOT the requested OOS window 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-08. The provided artifact shows quarter_pnl for 2025-Q1..2026-Q2. True OOS period (2026-07-01 onward) not separately reported in this run.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS — the requested 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-08 window was not isolated in this Stage-1 execution. The run mixes IS and OOS periods.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS — this is BS-synthetic pricing only (black_scholes). Per L12/L23, BS sim systematically over-estimates entry premium for ITM 0DTE; weekly spreads wider.
5. **Failure modes:** Engine loses on 2/3 J winner days (4/29, 5/01). Takes J loser days (5/07 x2). Max drawdown $4,701. Extreme concentration (top5_pct=999%). Win rate 18.7% — most trades are small losers.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 999% of P&L (i.e., rest of 220 trades net lose). The +$804 on 5/04 carries the entire edge_capture.
